title: ETOPO1 global relief model
publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (via ERDDAP)
description: Land elevation and ocean depth, sampled every ~4 km. Each hex's relief (flat, hills, mountains, peaks) comes from the mean and roughness (standard deviation) of the land samples inside it.
vintage: ETOPO1, 1 arc-minute, sampled every ~4 km

title: Aires d'attraction des villes 2020
description: Functional urban areas: a dense employment/population pole plus the communes sending at least 15% of workers to it. This is the closest French equivalent of US metropolitan areas.
vintage: AAV 2020, géographie au 01/01/2026

title: Agreste agricultural census 2020, commune indicators
publisher: Agreste / Ministère de l'Agriculture, mirrored by the Observatoire des territoires (ANCT)
description: Commune-level 2020 agricultural-census indicators downloaded through the ANCT/Observatoire des territoires Géoclip export API using the current com2026 communal geography. The pipeline uses the number of farms and utilised agricultural area. Blank cells mean no farm or statistical suppression and are not treated as measured zeros.
used_for: Farm density and average farm-size lenses
vintage: Agreste agricultural census 2020, ANCT communal geography 2026

title: Annual background air-pollution concentrations
description: Commune-level annual mean background concentrations combining air-quality measurements with CHIMERE model simulations. Values characterize background pollution, not localized peaks near roads or industrial sites; the upstream indicator is marked as under review and covers metropolitan France including Corsica, not overseas territories.
vintage: INERIS annual background air concentrations, 2024

title: Contours administratifs et communes de France
description: Current region, department and commune boundaries, with commune population, land area and centre from geo.api.gouv.fr. Metropolitan France and Corsica use their real positions; the five overseas department-regions are affine-placed in inset slots west of the mainland.
vintage: contours administratifs latest; géographie 2026

title: ARCEP fixed-broadband eligibility by commune
description: Counts of connectable premises by commune and technology from the Ma connexion internet statistical extract. The map lens uses fiber-to-the-home eligible premises divided by all premises.
vintage: ARCEP Ma connexion internet commune statistics, reference date 2026-06-30

title: Waste and circular-economy infrastructure
description: Current SINOE recycling-centre registry and server-side distinct-actor aggregations from ADEME's Que Faire De Mes Objets et Déchets circular-economy actor database. Circular-economy actors include crowd/contributed entries and a small number of establishments whose SIREN status is closed, so densities are infrastructure availability indicators rather than a statutory registry.
vintage: ADEME SINOE recycling centres, 2026; circular-economy actors, current open-data extract

title: Météo-France SIM2 monthly climate reanalysis
description: Monthly Safran-Isba reanalysis on an approximately 8 km grid since 1961. The pipeline compares 1961–1990 with 1996–2025, uses 1991–2020 climate normals for temperature and precipitation, and retains selected annual series.
vintage: Météo-France SIM2 monthly reanalysis, 1961–2025

title: CORINE Land Cover 2018, metropolitan France
publisher: SDES / Copernicus, served by IGN Géoplateforme
description: French land cover in 44 detailed classes, read through the IGN WMS at roughly 380 m resolution and translated into the renderer's biome classes.
used_for: Forest, farmland, developed and vineyard shares
vintage: CORINE Land Cover 2018, WMS raster ~380 m

title: Recorded crime by department
description: Departmental recorded-crime counts and rates per thousand residents from police and gendarmerie statistics.
vintage: Interior Ministry recorded crime, 2025

title: Museum attendance and university enrolment
description: Annual visitor counts for Musées de France, the Muséofile museum directory and SISE enrolment by public higher-education establishment. Multi-site museum attendance rows are summed for their shared Muséofile identifier after deduplicating repeated site rows. University geography is the administrative headquarters commune, not the footprint of every campus.
vintage: Musées de France attendance through 2024; SISE 2024-25

title: Base Nationale des Aménagements Cyclables, export national OpenStreetMap
description: National normalized export of cycling infrastructure digitized in OpenStreetMap, using the BNAC schema. Segment lengths are computed from WGS84 LineStrings; current-commune attribution uses INSEE municipal-merger mappings where necessary. Coverage reflects OpenStreetMap completeness and excludes overseas territories not in this metropolitan export.
vintage: BNAC OpenStreetMap export, 3 November 2026

title: 2017 and 2022 presidential elections, definitive second-round results
license: Mixed: 2017 Licence Ouverte (Etalab); 2022 license not specified in the mirrored dataset
description: Definitive second-round results by commune for 2017 and 2022, mirrored by data.gouv. Rows carry registered voters, abstention, valid ballots, and Macron/Le Pen votes; both elections opposed the same two candidates.
vintage: 2017 and 2022 presidential elections, definitive second-round results

title: Electricity consumption and thermosensitivity by commune and activity sector
description: Annual electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network, aggregated server-side by commune and broad activity sector, plus commune winter thermosensitivity indicators for the consumption year and electric-heating indicators from the most recent rows that publish that housing attribute. Enedis does not serve Corsica, overseas France or some local-distribution areas.
vintage: Enedis electricity consumption and thermosensitivity, 2025

title: National registry of electricity generation and storage installations
publisher: RTE, Enedis and network operators through Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ)
description: Installations of at least 500 kW connected to the French electricity networks, with sector, technology, maximum installed or discharge power, municipality and service status.
used_for: Power-plant and energy-storage resources on the map
vintage: ODRÉ national registry, latest published extract

title: RTE transmission network lengths and electrical sites
publisher: RTE through Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ)
description: Annual departmental lengths of RTE transmission circuits and pylon routes, plus the public registry of RTE transformation sites and connection points. RTE no longer publishes exact public network geometry for security reasons, so this extract uses reproducible departmental statistics rather than precise line or substation coordinates.
vintage: RTE network statistics, 2025; electrical sites current ODRÉ publication

title: Eurostat regional accounts, 2024
description: GDP, gross value added and employment by NUTS 3 region and high-level NACE industry. NUTS 3 units correspond to French departments, with Eurostat rather than INSEE codes.
vintage: Eurostat regional accounts, 2024

title: Base nationale consolidée IRVE, données statiques
description: Nightly consolidated and deduplicated static registry of public electric-vehicle charge points. Rows are individual charge points; the map aggregates valid rows to communes.
vintage: Base nationale consolidée IRVE, nightly static export

title: TRI physical river-flood exposure
description: Raster tiles from the official 2020 TRI synthesis WMS for rare or millennial river-overflow flooding and marine submersion. The pipeline downsamples them to the CORINE raster registration as approximate flood-area fractions. TRI coverage is limited to designated flood-risk territories.
used_for: Physical river-flood and coastal-submersion exposure lenses
vintage: TRI flood-risk synthesis, 2020 reporting

title: National goods-flow data, 2019
publisher: SDES / ministère de la Transition écologique
description: 2019 non-directional region-to-region goods flows by road, rail and inland waterway. The source publishes tonne-kilometres; some rail pairs are suppressed for statistical secrecy.
used_for: Freight trade routes and modal split
vintage: SDES national goods-flow data, 2019

title: GASPAR natural-disaster recognitions
publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique / Géorisques
description: National GASPAR export of catastrophe-naturelle recognitions. Each row is one recognition for one commune, event and hazard; it is an administrative insurance recognition, not a direct measure of damage. INSEE COG commune movements and delegated-commune parents map records through post-2000 municipal mergers.
vintage: GASPAR export 2026-11-02; recognitions 2000–2025

title: Localized potential accessibility to health professionals
description: Commune-level APL indicators for general practitioners, nurses, dentists and midwives. APL accounts for nearby supply and the age structure of demand; it is an accessibility indicator, not a count of practitioners.
vintage: DREES APL 2024

title: Immeubles protégés au titre des Monuments historiques
description: National Mérimée list of buildings protected as Monuments historiques. Rows are attributed to current communes through INSEE municipal-merger mappings where necessary; protection text distinguishes classified (classé) from registered (inscrit) protection.
vintage: Mérimée protected buildings, current ministry export

title: Median housing prices per m² by commune
description: Median sale prices per square metre by commune for apartments and houses, calculated from geolocated DVF transactions in 2024–2025. No individual transaction, parcel or address is redistributed. DVF excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.
vintage: DVF commune medians, sales in 2024–2025

title: DPE Logements existants (depuis juillet 2021)
description: Energy-performance diagnostics for existing housing since July 2021. Commune distributions are aggregated server-side from DPE A-G labels. DPEs are triggered mainly by sales, rentals and construction work, so they are a biased sample of the total housing stock rather than a census.
vintage: ADEME DPE existing housing since July 2021

title: Annual housing prices by commune, DVF 2014–2025
description: Annual median sale price per square metre and sale counts by commune for 2014–2025, for existing dwellings. Terralyse groups DVF lines by transaction, filters dwellings to 20–500 m² and €1,000–50,000/m², excludes new-build sales, and does not publish a median below five sales; sparse commune coverage is intentional missingness rather than zero-priced housing. Municipal-arrondissement rows in Paris, Lyon and Marseille are aggregated back to their parent communes with transaction-count weights. That arrondissement detail begins in 2021, so the three parent communes have no earlier annual rows. DVF excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.
vintage: Terralyse DVF commune annual series, sales 2014–2025, millésime 2026

title: IGN BD CARTO named watercourses
description: Named metropolitan watercourse segments at least 15 m wide, plus reservoir axes. The pipeline keeps the longest named rivers and simplifies their geometry for the map scale.
vintage: IGN BD CARTO V5 WFS

title: INSEE census and territory-comparator statistics
description: Recensement de la population 2023 tables from the Melodi catalogue, plus the comparateur de territoires population, income, poverty and housing series. Geographic levels include communes, EPCI, AAV, departments, regions and France depending on the table.
vintage: INSEE census 2023 and comparateur de territoires, geography 2026

title: Contours IRIS and 2022 census population
description: INSEE 2022 infra-communal census population by IRIS, joined to the IGN/INSEE Contours IRIS WFS. Communes not divided into IRIS are represented as whole-commune pseudo-IRIS so the statistical partition covers France; the population extract excludes Mayotte. Polygon centroids and areas are simplified analytical representations.
used_for: Neighborhood-scale population density and demographic lenses
vintage: INSEE census population 2022; Contours IRIS current export

title: Consumption of natural, agricultural and forest land 2011–2025
description: Annual commune indicators derived from French land-registry files: artificialized land stock and consumption of natural, agricultural and forest land by period and destination.
used_for: Artificialized-land, land-consumption and housing-driven consumption lenses
vintage: Cerema national soil-artificialization observatory, 2011–2025 communal extract (COG 2025)

title: Residential migration, principal census indicators
description: Census principal indicators for residence one year earlier, published at commune level for the 2012, 2017 and 2023 census vintages. Values are census-weighted population estimates, not net migration balances. The outside-department total includes arrivals from abroad or other overseas territories; the extract contains no Mayotte commune rows.
vintage: INSEE residential-migration principal indicators, census years 2012, 2017 and 2023

title: Defense-base personnel, 2012
description: Stationed personnel and formation counts by base de défense in 2012. The original XLS resource is no longer directly downloadable, so the pipeline uses data.gouv.fr's preserved Tabular API extraction of that resource. Detailed rows exclude most of Île-de-France; the file provides one aggregate Île-de-France total. This is historical administrative-open-data, not a current order of battle or a base-boundary inventory.
vintage: Ministry of the Armed Forces defense-base personnel, 2012

title: Mon Réseau Mobile operator site deployment
description: Quarterly operator-reported mobile-site deployment files for metropolitan and overseas France. Rows are operator-site records with 2G/3G/4G/5G capability flags. Site presence is a supply/competition proxy, not a theoretical coverage boundary or measured quality-of-service result.
vintage: ARCEP Mon Réseau Mobile sites, 2026 T2

title: INPN Natura 2000 protected areas
description: GeoJSON geometries of Natura 2000 habitat-directive and birds-directive sites, ZNIEFF ecological-inventory zones, national nature reserves, national parks and regional natural parks. ZNIEFF areas are knowledge/inventory zones rather than legal protection regimes. Geometries are simplified to approximately hectometre scale because the map samples them on an 8 km hex grid.
used_for: Protected nature, ecological-inventory and park lenses
vintage: INPN Natura 2000 via API Carto Nature, current export

title: Strategic noise maps for major transport infrastructure
publisher: CEREMA / Ministry for the Ecological Transition
description: 2022 strategic noise-map polygons (type A, Lden) for qualifying non-conceded roads and railways. Polygon areas are aggregated into 250 m local-projection bins by centroid, with overlapping infrastructure contributions capped at bin area. The dataset does not include Paris, Hauts-de-Seine, Seine-Saint-Denis or Val-de-Marne and does not represent urban-agglomeration, airport, industrial or concessionaire-network noise.
vintage: CEREMA strategic noise maps, 2022

title: Base permanente des équipements 2024, detailed equipment file
description: Detailed registry of publicly accessible equipment and services at 1 January 2024, using the stable data.gouv mirror of INSEE's parquet extract. Rows are counted with NBEQUIDENT where INSEE groups identical equipment; arrondissement codes are normalized to Paris, Lyon and Marseille commune totals.
used_for: Everyday-services, food-shop, pharmacy, sports/culture, hospital-service, childcare, eldercare, cinema, rail-station, postal, library, France Services, recycling-center and law-enforcement lenses
vintage: INSEE Base permanente des équipements 2024

title: Fichier de formes des lignes du Réseau Ferré National
description: Official geometries of national railway line sections. The pipeline keeps only sections marked Exploitée, classifying ordinary lines as main lines and connections/main/port tracks as secondary lines for map display.
vintage: SNCF Réseau national railway line shapes, current open-data export

title: SNCF passenger-station traffic
description: Annual passenger traffic by station and the SNCF passenger-station coordinate reference. The 2025 series uses a revised source and methodology and is not directly comparable with 2015–2024.
vintage: SNCF station traffic 2025

title: Géorisques risk-prevention perimeters
description: WMS raster samples of official French risk-prevention servitude perimeters for forest fire, avalanche, ground movement and industrial risk. The pipeline downsamples filled polygon coverage to the CORINE raster registration. These are administrative prevention perimeters, not probabilistic hazard intensity, damage or loss models.
used_for: Forest-fire, avalanche, ground-movement and industrial-risk prevention-perimeter lenses
vintage: Géorisques risk-prevention perimeters, current WMS publication

title: Géorisques natural-risk zoning rasters
description: WMS raster samples of official French clay shrink-swell exposure, seismic zoning and commune radon potential. The pipeline classifies pixels against the published legend colours and downsamples them to the CORINE raster registration. Clay and seismic layers are spatial hazard zones; radon is a commune-level potential class.
used_for: Clay shrink-swell, seismic and radon risk lenses
vintage: Géorisques/BRGM risk zoning, current WMS publication

title: Trafic moyen journalier annuel sur le réseau routier national 2024
publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique / Cerema (data.gouv mirror)
description: Official 2024 annual-average-daily-traffic sections on the French national road network, with Lambert-93 polyline geometry. Coverage is the national road network only; departmental and municipal roads are excluded, and some sections use earlier measurement years.
vintage: TMJA national road network 2024 reference year; section measurement years vary

title: Annuaire de l'Éducation nationale
description: Directory of open public and private schools, including type, commune, department and location.
vintage: Annuaire de l'Éducation nationale, current export

title: Taux de logements sociaux dans les communes
publisher: Caisse des Dépôts, SDES and INSEE
description: 2023 commune-level social-housing units in the RPLS as a percentage of primary residences. The published indicator excludes habitat spécifique and certain SEM stock and is not directly comparable with the legal SRU article-55 rate.
vintage: RPLS 2023 / INSEE primary residences

title: Frequentation of tourist accommodation
description: Monthly hotel nights spent by department from the INSEE Melodi tourist-accommodation occupancy dataset.
vintage: INSEE tourist accommodation occupancy, 2024

title: National GTFS scheduled service frequency
license: Various open licences catalogued by transport.data.gouv.fr
description: Experimental true scheduled-service extraction. It counts stop calls in GTFS stop_times for one representative Wednesday after applying calendar/calendar_dates exceptions and expanding frequency-based trips across their headway windows. Consolidated regional feeds are used where available. Supplemental feeds are selected for regions without consolidated coverage using catalog covered_area metadata. Aggregate resources are preferred where network metadata shows duplication, exact duplicate zip snapshots and content-duplicate feed publications are skipped, expired feeds are excluded, and overlapping supplemental stops inside consolidated regions are suppressed during map construction; residual catalog inconsistencies can remain.
vintage: Scheduled stop calls around 2026-12-09 from current GTFS feeds

title: Arrêts de transport en France
description: Experimental national extraction of stop points present in GTFS feeds catalogued by transport.data.gouv.fr. Rows are deduplicated by normalized stop name and approximately 100-metre rounded coordinates because the same stop can appear in several overlapping feeds. Stop presence does not measure service frequency, operating days, speed or reliability.
vintage: transport.data.gouv.fr GTFS stop extraction, current resource snapshot

title: French transport networks and hub traffic
license: Public domain / Eurostat free reuse policy
description: Natural Earth 1:10m road, railroad and port geometries; Eurostat avia_paoa airport passengers and mar_go_aa port tonnage (2023); OurAirports coordinates and names. Natural Earth network geometry is schematic map art rather than a complete infrastructure inventory.
vintage: Natural Earth v5.1.2; Eurostat transport 2023; OurAirports current extract

title: UNESCO World Heritage List
description: Official XML export of the World Heritage List, filtered to entries with at least one French component point in metropolitan France or Corsica. Serial properties keep one representative French point.
used_for: World Heritage wonders on the map
vintage: UNESCO World Heritage List, current XML export

title: Drinking-water regulatory compliance samples
description: 2025 drinking-water control samples. The pipeline uses Escherichia coli rows as one row per routine bacteriological sample and reads the repeated whole-sample regulatory conclusion, including mandatory-limit and quality-reference compliance fields.
vintage: Hub'eau drinking-water control samples, 2025

title: SISPEA drinking-water and wastewater service performance
publisher: Office français de la biodiversité / services.eaufrance.fr
description: Annual 2024 SISPEA service-price and performance indicators for drinking-water and collective-wastewater services. Multi-commune service territories are aggregated by the department of the managing body's headquarters, so departmental values are service-weighted approximations rather than exact territorial averages.
vintage: SISPEA service performance, 2024

title: Natural Earth 1:50m (countries, lakes, rivers)
description: Neighbouring countries (shown fogged), large lakes and major rivers. Files are pinned to the natural-earth-vector release v5.1.2.
vintage: Natural Earth v5.1.2 (1:50m)
